shell.editBanner: Edit mode is on. Add widgets, drag their headers to move and a corner to resize.
shell.notEditable: This is a built-in DWC page and can't be customised. Open the Dashboard or one of your own pages (Manage pages) to add widgets.

settings.caption: Flexible Layouts
settings.heading: Flexible Layouts
settings.subheading: Drag-and-drop control over every page, panel, colour and more.
settings.statusActive: The Flexible Layouts shell is active. Use the Edit button in the top bar to customise your pages.
settings.statusInactive: The built-in DWC layout is active. Switch to Flexible Layouts to start customising.
settings.pickerHint: You can also pick the active layout under Settings → General → Display (use that when several layout plugins are installed).
settings.escapeHint: Stuck? You can always return to the built-in layout by visiting

editor.headerAlignRight: Move to the right side of the bar
editor.headerAlignLeft: Move to the left side of the bar
editor.rearrange: Tidy up — pack panels to use the least space
editor.pack: Pack tight — rearrange panels for the best fit (removes the most dead space)
editor.previewHint: Hover a widget to preview it
editor.emptyEditing: This page is empty. Add a widget to get started.
editor.emptyView: This page has no widgets yet.
editor.seedHelp: Start with a blank page, or begin from the panels this page currently shows so you can rearrange them.

widget.panelError: The “{name}” panel could not be displayed here.
widget.panelMissing: Panel “{name}” is not available in this DWC build.
widget.unknownWidget: Unsupported widget “{type}” (from a newer/older layout). Delete it in edit mode.

widgets.label: Text / image
widgets.pluginPageMissing: “{name}” isn’t available — its plugin may not be loaded.

properties.title: Widget settings
properties.label: Label
properties.codeHint: Multiple lines allowed. Run a macro with M98 P"/macros/Name".
properties.webHint: Many public sites block embedding; local services and webcams usually work.
properties.urlRootRel: a path served by the Duet itself
properties.webEmbedNote: Many public sites (Google, BBC, the Duet forum…) refuse to be shown inside a frame and appear blank — that's the site's own policy, not a fault here. Embed-friendly dashboards, webcams and your own local web services work.
properties.httpCorsNote: The endpoint must return text/JSON and allow cross-origin requests (CORS), or be served by the Duet. Public APIs that block CORS show ⚠.
properties.inputModeCommand: Run a command with the value
properties.commandTemplateHint: Use {value} where the entered value goes, e.g. M104 S{value}
properties.expressionHint: Arithmetic transform applied to the value, e.g. x / 60 or (x - 32) * 5 / 9. Supports + - * / and parentheses.
properties.tooltipHint: Shown when hovering over the panel (outside edit mode).
properties.builtinNote: “{name}” is a built-in DWC panel. It has no extra settings here; configure it via its own controls.

conditions.title: Conditional behaviour
conditions.help: When the object-model value matches, apply the effects below. Rules are checked in order.
conditions.hiddenHint: Hidden by a condition (shown while editing)

inputModifier.title: Input modifier
inputModifier.help: Transform the value before it's sent — the input equivalent of the value box's formatting. The map is checked first; otherwise the number is scaled/offset, then run through the expression.
inputModifier.expressionHint: x is the entered value after scale/offset, e.g. "x * 60" to send minutes as seconds.

printLock.widgetHint: Blocks interaction with this widget while a print is running, so it can't move the machine unexpectedly. On by default for motion / tool-change controls; off for safe ones like pause.
printLock.pageHint: Blocks interaction with every widget on this page during a print, regardless of each widget's own setting.

sdBackup.title: SD-card backup
sdBackup.hint: Saves your whole layout (all profiles) to the printer's SD card each time you finish editing, so it survives DWC settings being wiped — e.g. when switching between DWC 3.6 and 3.7.
sdBackup.auto: Back up to SD when I press Done
sdBackup.backupOk: Layout backed up to the SD card.
sdBackup.backupEmpty: Nothing to back up yet — add some pages or widgets first.
sdBackup.backupFailed: Couldn't write the backup to the SD card.
sdBackup.noBackup: No layout backup was found on the SD card.
sdBackup.restored: Layout restored from the SD-card backup.
sdBackup.restoreNowConfirm: Replace your current layout with the SD-card backup from {date} ({count} profile(s))? Your current layout will be replaced.
sdBackup.restoreBody: Your layout is empty, but a backup was found on the printer's SD card. Restore it?

theme.title: Theme & colours
theme.help: Recolours the whole interface. Blank colours inherit the light/dark base.
theme.customColorsHint: Define named colours here; they appear in every widget and panel colour picker so you can reuse a palette across the layout.

activate.title: Use Flexible Layouts?
activate.prompt: Switch DWC to the fully customisable Flexible Layouts interface now? You can always return with /BuiltInLayout or from Settings.

lock.title: Edit lock
lock.help: Require a password to edit the layout or switch back to the built-in interface. A soft kiosk lock — it deters casual changes but isn't security (it can be bypassed with browser dev tools).
lock.enable: Require a password to edit / leave this layout
lock.promptHelp: Enter the password to make changes or leave this layout.

errorBoundary.title: This page hit an error
errorBoundary.help: The custom layout couldn't render this page. Your layout data is safe.

profiles.title: Layout profiles
profiles.help: Keep several complete interfaces (e.g. FFF, CNC, Simple) and switch between them. Switching swaps all pages, widgets and theme.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete the profile “{name}” and everything in it? This can't be undone.

pageSettings.title: Page settings
pageSettings.resetHelp: Choose what to clear. A single screen size removes just that layout (tablet/phone revert to inheriting); “Everything” also clears the background and grid. This can't be undone.

typography.title: Text & size
typography.fitHint: Shrinks the widget to fit its cell instead of showing scrollbars.
typography.autoHeightHint: Resizes the cell to the panel's content and reflows the panels below — like the stock dashboard (e.g. Movement growing when axes aren't homed). Best for content-sized panels, not charts.
typography.responsiveHint: Treats the font size as a maximum and scales the text down on narrower screens (to a legible floor) so it stays readable on phones and tablets.

group.name: Panel title
group.empty: This panel is empty. Add widgets to build it.

jog.configHint: Pick which machine axis each control drives, then set the step amounts. Tip: right-click any ring or Z button on the widget to change its value.

neopixel.none: No LED strips found. Configure them in config.g with M950 E… C"…".

globals.namesHint: Pick from detected globals, or type a name.

alert.hidden: Shown only when the condition is true

webcam.unset: Set a webcam image or stream URL.

macros.none: No macros found in this folder.

toolAlign.noUrl: Set a camera URL in this widget's settings.
toolAlign.noPos: Machine X/Y position unavailable — home the axes first.
toolAlign.notHomed: X/Y not homed — captured positions may be wrong.
toolAlign.persistHint: G10 offsets apply immediately. Add them to config.g / tpost or save with M500 to keep them after a reset.

hotspot.hint: Positions are percentages of the image. Outlines show while editing.
hotspot.unset: Set an image URL to place clickable regions.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Captures plugin/firmware versions, recent errors and a privacy-scrubbed object model (network details and file names redacted) for a bug report.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — use Download report instead.

updates.title: Updates
updates.skipped: Version {version} skipped — Check now will show it again.
updates.needConnection: Connect to your machine to install the update.
updates.needsDwc: Needs DuetWebControl {dwc} (you have {running}). Update DuetWebControl first, then update the plugin.
updates.notifyPlugin: Flexible Layouts {version} is available — open the plugin settings to update.
updates.notifyDwc: Flexible Layouts {version} is available but needs DuetWebControl {dwc}. Update DuetWebControl first.
updates.corsBlocked: One-click update blocked by CORS. Downloading the ZIP directly — upload it to DWC's plugin installer.
updates.installedReload: Flexible Layouts {version} installed. Reload the page to finish.
updates.installedReloadBanner: Update installed — reload the page to start using the new version.

dro.axesHint: Comma-separated letters, e.g. X, Y, Z.

messageBox.note: Shows the firmware message box (M291) and acknowledges it (M292) when one is active. No configuration needed.

io.title: Backup & share
io.shareHelp: Made a layout you love? Share it with the community so others can use it.
io.shareLink: Contribute it to the layout gallery
io.importHeading: Import a layout, page or widget
io.importHelp: Load a .dwclayout.json (whole layout), .dwcpage.json (single page) or .dwcpanel.json (single widget). Pages and widgets are added as a new page. A BtnCmd export (.json) is converted automatically.
io.replaceExisting: Replace my current layout (delete existing pages)
io.additiveHint: Your existing pages are kept; the imported pages are added alongside them.
io.replaceHint: Your current pages will be deleted and replaced by the imported ones.
io.undoHint: Restores the automatic backup taken just before your most recent import.
io.importedPanel: Widget imported onto a new page.
io.replaceWarning: Importing replaces your current layout (all pages, widgets and theme).
io.missingHelp: This layout embeds pages from plugins you don’t have. Those tiles will show a placeholder until you install them.
io.samplesHelp: Add a ready-made page to your layout (doesn’t replace anything).
io.exportPanel: Export this panel to a file
io.exportPage: Export this page to a file
io.galleryHelp: Browse layouts shared by the community and import them with one click.
io.galleryOffline: Couldn’t reach the gallery — check your internet connection and try again.

error.notALayout: That doesn’t look like a Flexible Layouts file.
error.notAPanel: That isn’t a Flexible Layouts panel file.
error.notAPage: That isn’t a Flexible Layouts page file.

pages.title: Manage pages
pages.startupPageHint: The page this layout opens to when it loads. Leave blank for the normal landing page.
pages.jobStartPageHint: Go to this page when a print starts. Supplements DWC's "switch to Job page on print start" — turn that off and pick any page here. Leave blank to stay put.
pages.deleteConfirm: Delete the page “{name}” and its layout? This can't be undone.
pages.conditionHelp: Show this page in the menu only while the object-model rule below matches. Leave the path blank to always show it.
